system_identifier.description: Unique system identifier used for bundle signing verification and slot labeling.

device_compatible.description: Optional device tree compatible string for automatic slot detection on embedded devices.

statefile.description: Path to the persistent state file tracking slot statuses and upgrade history.

guile_enabled.description: Enable Guile scripting for custom update logic (advanced users only).

db_backend.description: Database backend used by the RAUC service to store update state.

db_path.description: File path for the service database (used when db_backend is 'sqlite' or 'file').

api_host.description: Hostname or IP address the RAUC service API should bind to (empty = all interfaces).

api_port.description: TCP port for the RAUC service API.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the RAUC service API.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate for the RAUC service.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key for the RAUC service.

tls_ca_path.description: Path to the CA certificate used to validate client certificates.

allowed_signers.description: List of allowed bundle signer identifiers (certificate common names or SHA256 hashes).

max_bundle_size.description: Maximum allowed bundle size in bytes (0 = no limit).

idle_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds for the RAUC service API.

autoupdater_enabled.description: Enable automatic update checking and installation.

check_interval.description: Time in seconds between automatic update checks.

boot_check_delay.description: Seconds to wait after boot before marking a new slot as 'good'.

recovery_boot.description: Behavior when booting a newly installed slot fails.

update_providers.description: List of update provider URLs and optional TLS/config overrides.

items.description: Configuration for a single update provider.

description.description: Human-readable name for the provider (for logging/debugging).

url.description: Base URL of the update provider (must end with '/').

tls_cert.description: Optional client TLS certificate for the provider.

tls_key.description: Optional client TLS private key for the provider.

tls_ca.description: Optional CA certificate for provider TLS validation.

ca_name.description: Expected CA name in TLS certificates (SNI-style validation).

ignore_checksum.description: Skip checksum verification (insecure; only for testing).

slot_name.description: Specific slot name to install updates into (overrides default behavior).
